description: The agent must: (1) Locate the skill at skills/deck-narrative-planner/ and read its SKILL.md, spec.json, and template.md to understand the proprietary output structure. (2) Use the CLI invocation `python3 skills/deck-narrative-planner/scripts/run.py --input raw_materials/clinical/novapulse_board_deck_draft.md --output <path>/board_deck_narrative.md` — first in scaffold mode to get the template, then fill it in and re-run in validate mode to confirm exit code 0. (3) Produce a board_deck_narrative.md containing ALL six required Chinese-labeled sections: 整体主线, 页级标题 (≥6 numbered items), 证据需求, 过渡语, 风险页, 结尾行动. (4) Also include 任务书 (restructured task brief, per Rule 1) and 待确认项 (which MUST explicitly flag the unknown target audience as unresolved, per Rule 2 — not fabricated). (5) Order the document with 可审阅草案 appearing before 可执行清单 (per Rule 3). (6) Must NOT invent the unnamed advisor or the missing audience. The proprietary traps are: the 任务书 restructuring step, the 待确认项 requirement for missing info, the strict section ordering rule, and the Chinese-labeled 6-section output schema that no generic agent would produce without reading the skill.
